name: Da Mamma Lucia
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Da Mamma Lucia in Mittenwald**

Discover authentic Italian cuisine in the heart of the Alps! At **Da Mamma Lucia**, we bring the flavors of Italy to the charming village of **Mittenwald**, nestled in the stunning **Tirol** region.

Our cozy restaurant invites you to savor traditional dishes like fresh pasta, crispy **Arancini**, and mouthwatering **Tiramisu**. Whether you're craving a hearty **Lasagne** or a light **Caprese Salad**, our menu has something for every palate.

After your meal, enjoy a rich **Espresso** or a creamy **Tiramisu** to complete your Italian experience. Come and enjoy the warmth of Italian hospitality in the breathtaking surroundings of **Tirol**!

We look forward to welcoming you at **Da Mamma Lucia** in **Mittenwald**. **Buon appetito!**
